notes.title: Week three build update and news!
notes.notes:
A new build has been pushed to Steam that includes a lot of fixes. 
-Seriously, a lot.

For testing, we replaced game saves two through five with ones that unlock progression at increments of 20%. That should give everyone a chance to see and test everything we have to offer- vanity unlocks and all.

Enjoy and please give feedback to make Mekazoo the best it can be!
